body:
I start up a client that has a T4 GPU (g4dn.xlarge aws instance) and I told the dashboard it has 16GB ,but when I launch the client it is very opinionated: Well actually I am saying the GPU has 16384 MB when it really has only 15360 MB. Perhaps this could be handled a bit more gracefully, since even Nvidia is selling these GPU as 16GB 

/var/tmp/cloud/startup/start.sh

```
Error processing config ['/var/tmp/cloud/startup/../startup/fed_client.json', '/var/tmp/cloud/startup/../local/resources.json.default']: ConfigError: Error processing '/var/tmp/cloud/startup/../startup/fed_client.json' in element '{"id": "resource_manager", "path": "nvflare.app_common.resource_managers.gpu_resource_manager.GPUResourceManager", "args": {"num_of_gpus": 1, "mem_per_gpu_in_GiB": 16}}': path: 'components.#1', exception: 'ValueError: Memory per GPU specified (16384) exceeds available GPU memory: 15360.'
ConfigError: ConfigError: Error processing '/var/tmp/cloud/startup/../startup/fed_client.json' in element '{"id": "resource_manager", "path": "nvflare.app_common.resource_managers.gpu_resource_manager.GPUResourceManager", "args": {"num_of_gpus": 1, "mem_per_gpu_in_GiB": 16}}': path: 'components.#1', exception: 'ValueError: Memory per GPU specified (16384) exceeds available GPU memory: 15360.'
2024-05-06 05:10:50,439 - MPM - INFO - MPM: Good Bye!
```

comments.body: Thank you, I did make this adjustment and it is explained in the documentation. I just submitted this to help improving usability of nvflare as most user would run into this issue at first
Got it, thanks for sharing your experience!

title: Client is very opinionated about actual GPU memory
